questions.question: When you hear the topic “Work, careers & business”, what is the first thing that comes to mind?
ideasZh: 第一句直接给出人、物或经历
补充时间和场景
用 because 解释它为何突出
questions.templateEn: The first thing that comes to mind is ___. I first noticed it when ___. What stands out most is ___, mainly because ___.
questions.sampleAnswerEn: The first thing that comes to mind is completing a difficult task with help from a teacher or colleague. It was an ordinary moment, but it relates closely to “Work, careers & business”. What stood out most was how personal the experience felt. I remember it clearly because it gave me a more concrete understanding of work and education and made the topic much easier to talk about.

questions.question: Is “Work, careers & business” important or common in your daily life?
ideasZh: 先回答程度：very / fairly / not particularly
给一个最近的具体例子
用一句结果或感受收尾
questions.templateEn: It is fairly ___ in my daily life. For instance, ___. As a result, it helps me / makes me feel ___.
questions.sampleAnswerEn: It is fairly relevant to my daily life, although I do not think about it all the time. For instance, I recently had completing a difficult task with help from a teacher or colleague. That experience reminded me that this topic can influence ordinary decisions. Overall, I value it because it can bring knowledge, independence and better future opportunities.

questions.question: Has your opinion about “Work, careers & business” changed over time?
ideasZh: 用 used to 交代过去的看法
说明改变看法的具体经历
用 now / these days 给出当前观点
questions.templateEn: I used to think ___. My view changed when ___. These days, I tend to ___ because ___.
questions.sampleAnswerEn: Yes, it has changed to some extent. I used to see the topic as something quite ordinary and I rarely paid attention to it. My view changed after completing a difficult task with help from a teacher or colleague. That experience helped me notice its practical side and the effect it can have on daily choices. These days, I think about it more carefully because it can bring knowledge, independence and better future opportunities.

questions.question: Describe an experience connected with “Work, careers & business” that you remember clearly. You should say: when and where it happened; who was involved; what happened; and explain why you remember it.
ideasZh: 背景：时间、地点、人物各一句
经过：按 before–during–after 讲三步
细节：加入一个可见、可听或可感的细节
意义：说明改变、感受或学到什么
questions.templateEn: I’d like to talk about ___. It happened when ___. At first, ___. What happened next was ___. The detail I remember most is ___. Looking back, it mattered to me because ___.
questions.sampleAnswerEn: I’d like to talk about completing a difficult task with help from a teacher or colleague, which is the experience I connect most strongly with “Work, careers & business”. It happened last year on a fairly ordinary day, and one other person was involved. At first, I did not expect anything special, but a small detail changed the whole experience. I had to make a quick decision, explain what I thought and then deal with the result. The detail I remember most is the relaxed conversation afterwards. Looking back, it mattered because it showed me the value of knowledge, independence and better future opportunities. It also gave me a real story rather than an abstract opinion, so I can still describe the moment clearly today.

ideasZh: 先给核心原因，不要只说 important
从个人影响扩展到社会影响
承认一个限制或代价
用 therefore 总结
questions.templateEn: I think it matters mainly because ___. On an individual level, ___. From a wider perspective, ___. Admittedly, ___. Even so, ___.
questions.sampleAnswerEn: I think it matters mainly because it can provide knowledge, independence and better future opportunities. On an individual level, it affects the choices people make and the way they organise daily life. From a wider perspective, it can shape how communities use time, money and public resources. questions.question: How might work and education change in the next ten years?
ideasZh: 提出一个最可能的变化
解释推动因素：科技、成本、政策或观念
比较受益者与可能被落下的人
避免绝对预测，用 may / likely to
questions.templateEn: Over the next decade, I expect ___. The main driver will probably be ___. This could benefit ___, although ___. So the change is likely to be ___ rather than ___.
questions.sampleAnswerEn: Over the next decade, I expect that flexible learning and artificial intelligence may change how people study and work. The main driver will probably be a mixture of technology, changing expectations and cost. This could benefit people who are willing and able to adapt, although others may need extra support. So the change is likely to be gradual rather than immediate. The basic human need behind the topic will remain, but the way people respond to it may look quite different.

questions.question: Do different generations think differently about “Work, careers & business”?
ideasZh: 明确比较对象：younger / older people
各给一个原因，避免刻板印象
指出共同点或例外
以平衡判断收尾
questions.templateEn: There is a difference, but it is not absolute. Younger people tend to ___ because ___. Older people may prefer ___ since ___. However, both groups ___.
questions.sampleAnswerEn: There is a difference, but it is not absolute. Younger people are often quicker to accept new ways of doing things because they encounter them through school, work and social media. Older people may place more value on familiarity and proven experience. However, both groups usually care about convenience, security and meaningful results.
